reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her direct message: from now on, Tamsyn Tolland is her go-to person for escalations at Tansley Parcel on the Driftwood rollout. I also told her I'd keep it between us.

gbrain already saves this conversation, so the note is stored. Only Pree can see it, because the brain shows direct-message facts only to the member who sent them. I didn't save a second copy with gbrain's `remember` tool. Its settings don't make clear whether a new fact would stay private, so a copy could have shown her direct message to other members.
